summary:
Not only did I hear from you but also from Patrice Duvic, whom we both know and who writes to say he visited you before he returned to Paris. When he was here staying with Tessa and me we discussed this. I’m sure he mentioned staying with us to you, but if he didn’t, what took place was that he came here directly from the Con and stayed about two weeks. I knew him from last year, when he came to my former house in San Rafael to conduct an interview with me. Part of that interview is now in print in Galaxie in French, and I have a copy—I can’t read it, and am waiting for him to send me a transcript of the origi­ nal English version. Do you read French, Tom (can I call you that?)? I’d like to give you a copy of the interview. What do you say? 

Patrice seems to have seen more of my recent life that just about anybody else, and I mention this hoping that he told you a little about me, and I am hop­ ing he told you a little about me because I would herewith like to introduce myself to you as a person, a man, rather than a writer, and would like to get to know you, too, as such. Of course I am premusing (“premusing”? Wow. I mean, presuming) that you do want to know me as a person and a man. I hope so. What you said about me in the introduction to THE RUINS OF EARTH meant so much to me that (get ready) I tore it out and carry it around with me in my wallet wherever I go.
